items.guidance: The compose.yaml mounts ./data to /app/data for the uptime-kuma service; inspect what the app writes there (database file, uploads, screenshots, config) and classify each as cache or durable. Check whether the app already exposes a storage or data-directory setting that can target S3 before changing code; if none exists, move only the durable reads and writes to the AWS SDK using STORAGE_BUCKET and AWS_REGION.

Since pg is present but no migration script exists in package.json, check whether the server applies its schema on startup (for example a Knex-based migration or schema setup in the server code) and report that file. If it does not, report any standalone migration command, or report that no migration mechanism exists.
